gen-eater-gf-basic: Basic reads crisp and tidy, with capitals barely taller than the small letters. Eater sits above it with dark, aggressive menace and wide gaps between its letters, and that clash of moods is what holds the pair together.
gen-eater-gf-farro: Approachable, that's Farro, with its compressed ascenders and tubing-like lines of no stroke contrast. Beneath Eater's dark, aggressive heading, paragraphs in it would feel friendly and steady, a calm counterweight to the menace above.
gen-eater-gf-geom: Eater's strokes sit between monoline and razor-thin, with no hairlines at all, so the heading looks dark and sturdy. Geom follows in a lofty lowercase band, and the plain sans body gives the pair its modern, approachable edge.
gen-eater-gf-magra: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between its letters and short ascenders over a heavy frame. Magra counters with big-bodied lowercase.
gen-eater-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, with generous sidebearings and curves that sweep open. Major Mono Display lights each line with precise, technical calm, while Eater's dark, aggressive heading looms over it.
gen-eater-gf-martian-mono: Eater's hairline-free thin strokes and wide gaps make it dark and aggressive. Martian Mono, a monospace with loose, generous letters, can take a modest size under it.
gen-eater-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its tall lowercase letters like rolled cord, clean and neutral, with low variation in stroke weight. Eater's dark heading hangs over it, and the two pull in opposite directions.
gen-eater-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee brings chunky, tall lowercase letters that feel approachable and clean. Mukta Mahee would hold its own even if Eater's heading shrank, since that dark display face needs room.
gen-eater-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani reads contemporary and level, with a high-waisted lowercase. Under Eater's dark, aggressive heading, whole paragraphs in this sans would feel smooth and unhurried, an easy ride after the heavy headline.
gen-eater-gf-narnoor: Narnoor keeps its short ascenders above big bowls, a professional plain sans that stays out of the way. If Eater shrank, its dark heft would fade.
